messages.author: 8c6cfeb3076adeb4
messages.subject: Relative survival
parts:
Hi,

I would like to use INLA in the relative survival framework.
A poisson formulation can be used in this setting, but with a non-standard link function.

More precisely, the mean λ is related to the linear predictor η by log(λ - d) = η, where d is a known value.

Is it possible to add this specific link-function in INLA.

Thank you. Best regards. Olivier

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Relative survival
parts:
This should be

inla.doc("logoffset")

just set beta = d, and all covariates to 1.

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Relative survival
parts:
Initially its intended for the case where your 'd' is negative, so that
\lambda -d > 0, for sure. If this is the not the case, there will be an
issue with that, and you might have to run with d=0 as an initial value
to d = a little.larger, and so on
